about_the_game:
After a lifetime of failed spells and broken dreams the weary wizard Wander has settled in a small mountain village, hoping to leave magic behind. He opens a modest teashop spending his days brewing simple blends and listening to the quiet stories of the townsfolk.

By the time he realizes a strange fog similar to a brainmist surrounds the village clouding minds and twisting memories. Though Wander once swore never to use magic again, he begins to wonder if his forgotten craft might hold the key to lifting the fog.

Perhaps a touch of magic in each cup could heal what the mist has taken.
Perhaps this time, his spells will finally work.

  • Run your own teashop
    Brew and serve magical teas to townsfolk each with their own story to uncover.

  • Cast spells into your blends
    Infuse your teas with spells to affect the world and your customers in mysterious ways.

  • Roll for magic
    Every spell requires a roll of the die (d20). High rolls may produce powerful effects… but low ones could have unexpected consequences.

  • Discover new spells through adventure
    Leave your cozy teashop and venture into the surrounding enchanted woods. Defeat strange creatures and learn new spells from them.
